surprising: Spreadsheet work has explicit calculation or reference problems in three of four relevant entries, despite being as frequent as writing. Frequency alone does not establish weakness; the reported errors do.

recommended.rationale: Structured spreadsheet editing and verification address reported calculation and reference errors.

headline: Writing: covered; spreadsheet work: critical friction.
strongestBasis: Writing is the strongest relative measured category because no explicit friction is reported, while spreadsheet work has repeated explicit friction. This does not establish writing proficiency or successful completion.

interpretation.scope: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model’s intelligence.
interpretation.covered: Covered means sufficient task exposure with no explicit friction reported; it is not evidence of successful task performance.
interpretation.critical: At least three relevant entries, at least two explicit friction entries, and friction in at least half of relevant entries.
interpretation.limitations: Only requests are available; reported defects cannot be attributed to a particular agent, and repairs are not verified.
interpretation.recommendations: Recommendations are relevant rather than confirmed missing installations.
